cwe_descriptions: CWE-20: Improper Input Validation — The product receives input or data, but it does not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the properties that are required to process the data safely and correctly.
CWE-400: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption — The product does not properly control the allocation and maintenance of a limited resource.
CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write — The product writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.
